findings.reason: without the edge a coordinator dispatching §24 cannot see it rests on §6's landed figure store and §19's refusal, so the plan's own dependency convention is silently broken for exactly the section whose subject is another section's mechanism.
findings.text: `plan-section-depends-on` gives `s24` no entry though §24 presupposes §6's landed rubric-keyed figure store (it writes and reads the figure record through `stored_record(rubric="figure")`) and cites §19's refusal as its premise, which every other section in this cluster declares (s22→s6, s23→s20)

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `record_finding_disposition`, `stored_record`, `stored_record_for_disposition`, `repair.blocking_findings`, `read_review`, `reckon/crew/review_dispositions.py`, `reckon/crew_run_commands.py` and `tests/test_crew_help_names_its_state.py` all resolve; §24 carries no href.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §24's measure names four concrete outcomes (figure write, receipt read from the figure record, unchanged text path, refusal naming the absence) plus a declared control that falsifies the write ("with the rubric dropped before `stored_record`, the figure finding stays listed as blocking and the test fails").
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — every log is written under the run directory, not a session scratchpad or a node-local temporary path.
rubric_items.naming: pass — no plan label, ticket number or version tag reaches the new option or any symbol; `--rubric figure` is a data value, not a stage name.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause is reproduced in the code (`reckon/crew/review_dispositions.py:438` calls `stored_record` with no rubric, so it selects non-figure records; :321 `stored_record_for_disposition` takes no rubric either), the mechanism described (`--rubric` threaded into both the write and the receipt) is capable of satisfying the done-when, and the production caller, `crew dispose`, is named.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — one deliverable: `crew dispose --rubric figure` answering a figure finding.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — §24 declares no `plan-section-depends-on` entry, though its work reads and rewrites the figure-review record whose schema and rubric-keyed store §6 landed and answers §19's refusal, while every other section in this cluster declares its premise (s22→s6, s23→s20, s19→s18, s20→s18).
